messages:
incident-bot: Pager: P1 - metering spike detected. Token emit divergence between primary emitter and aggregator. Redis backlog growing. Affected: subset of hosted API keys. alert_id=mb-17321

matt_sre: oncall paged. i'll jump in, grabbing context.

sasha_oncall: i'm on it, taking lead. looking at consumer lag and recent deploys. :eyes:

billing-bot: quick snapshot: primary_count=1,234,567 aggregator_count=1,103,210 (delta +11.6%) over last 5m. overage flags triggered for ~18 keys.

mike_billing: seeing a flurry of automated overage emails queued for that window. can we pause notifications?

sasha_oncall: yes - pausing billing notifications now. running prod-toggle:notifications=false

alex_prod: please pause before customers get more emails. i'll hold a customer comms draft. :pray:

sasha_oncall: done. command: curl -X POST https://infra-toggle/api/v1/toggles -d '{"key":"billing.notifications","value":false}' # confirmed false

matt_sre: what's root cause so far? any config/rollback needed?

sasha_oncall: initial theory: consumer group cg-metering-4 showed periodic GC stalls after 2024-11-03 deploy -> lag spikes -> duplicate transform applied in aggregator path. checking logs.

olivia_research: logs show a double-apply of token multiplier in transformer v2.4.0 on nodes 7-9. stack snippet:

```
transform: tokens = tokens * config.token_multiplier
...
transform: tokens = tokens * config.token_multiplier
```

olivia_research: repro'd in staging with the v2.4.0 jar.

sasha_oncall: ok patch incoming. rolling hotfix to prod to remove duplicate multiply. will deploy to one pod first (canary).

mike_billing: scheduling reconciler to suppress false overage flags for window 1732108800-1732109400 (approx 12:00-12:10 UTC). will mark suppressed in billing dashboard.

alex_prod: thanks — i'll hold the customer note until we confirm stabilization.

sasha_oncall: canary rollback applied, consumer group autoscale set to +2 instances to drain backlog. starting backfill reprocess for affected offsets. job id: backfill-17321-a

incident-bot: Annotation: severity downgraded to P2 (symptom contained, notifications paused).

matt_sre: I'll own the watch for the next 30m. If delta > 2% re-page oncall.

sasha_oncall: monitoring dashboard: delta trending down to +0.5% after backfill. KV cache warm, redis backlog dropping.

mike_billing: reconcilier job completed. flagged entries corrected, 18 customers suppressed from false overage emails. will run full reconciliation in 2h to ensure no residuals.

olivia_research: hotfix merged to main (remove-dup-multiplier). deployment id: deploy-17321-hotfix. unit tests added to cover transform idempotency.

alex_prod: customer note draft: "We detected transient billing telemetry discrepancies between 12:00-12:10 UTC. Proactive measures taken: notifications paused, counts reconciled, and a fix deployed. No customer bills have been permanently changed; we will reconfirm in the follow-up."

sasha_oncall: handoff plan: matt_sre will watch until 1732110296 then close if stable. postmortem assigned to olivia_research + mike_billing.

matt_sre: ack. ping me if any regression. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident closed to active pager state. Follow-up ticket created: INC-17321-metering-shadow-count.
